settings.title: DIY BACKFIRES
settings.text: Toothpaste, household cleaners, magic erasers... all of these can damage materials, strip color, soften the glue, or ruin the sneaker totally.

settings.title: REPLACING IS EXPENSIVE
settings.text: That $200 purchase will quickly cost you $400 if you don't use the right system to properly clean your shoes. You don't need to buy a new pair, you need to clean the pair you already own.

settings.title: WRONG SOLUTION
settings.text: Household cleaners are not made for shoe materials. Suede, nubuck, leather, knit, mesh, are not your counter top or dishes. The wrong product will permanently damage your sneakers.

settings.title: DRY
settings.text: Let the shoes dry for 24 hours. Use a towel to dab only if there is excess product. Apply a second coat — essential for best results.

settings.title: SPRAY
settings.text: Spray evenly to cover every area. Avoid soaking the fabric.

settings.title: SHAKE
settings.text: Clean and dry the shoes before applying. Shake well and hold the bottle about 8 inches from the shoes.
